ValidationRule.description: Update Sent To Operations must be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType_Name__c = "CAC - DP Closure" && OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Update_Sent_To_Operations__c) && NOT(ISBLANK(Update_Sent_To_Operations__c)) && DATEVALUE(Update_Sent_To_Operations__c) != TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Update_Sent_To_Operations__c)) || DATEVALUE(Update_Sent_To_Operations__c) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Update_Sent_To_Operations__c)) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Update_Sent_To_Operations__c)) && DATEVALUE(Update_Sent_To_Operations__c) != TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Update Sent To Operations must be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future.
